Full graph: use the numbered detail sheets for presentation or printing.
Only actual Java source types are represented. Framework/JDK classes are external.
Constructors and compiler/Lombok-generated boilerplate are omitted.
Frontend is React function components; it does not declare Java domain classes.
Solid hollow triangle: inheritance | Dashed hollow triangle: interface realization
Filled diamond: composition | Hollow diamond: shared aggregation
Arrow: stored association | Dashed arrow: dependency
Source snapshot: 22 November 2026 | com.iitsm backend | Explicit members; generated accessors omitted
